gitUrl: must be an https:// or git@ address
localPathOwner: exactly one of terminalId, cardId or projectId is required
cardOrProject: exactly one of cardId or projectId is required
zoomUserOnly: only the user can reset to the default
loginOrigin: must be an http(s) origin (e.g. https://example.com)
dateKey: must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format
safeAbsPath: must be an absolute, safe path
flowId: the flow name must be a single .mmd file name
absOrHomePath: must be an absolute path or start with ~/
folderName: must be a folder name, not a path
indexBelowTotal: index must be less than total

auth.keyRule: The key must be at least {min} random bytes (base64url ≥43 or hex ≥64 characters). To make one: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes({min}).toString('base64url'))" — or use the engine's engine.key file.

handshake.outdatedEngine: The engine is outdated; update it on the Mac mini (pnpm deploy:local). The key was not sent.
handshake.unverified: The server at this address could not prove it is the engine; not connected, the key was not sent.
handshake.protocol: The handshake with the engine is broken; not connected.

appUpdate.reservedBuildId: reserved name, cannot be a build ID

bundle.parentFirst: the parent folder must be listed first, as a folder
bundle.linkOutside: a link must lead to a listed place inside the bundle
